settings: Inherit unchanged VK04 per-scale optimizer, loss, seeds, budgets and checkpoint selection.
pooling: Mean chunks within document; mean documents within source; masked source attention without an additive source embedding; structured late fusion. D explicitly uses the original VK04 head path.
source_policy: Frozen VK02 v2 accepted documents only. Raw platform is used only to reconstruct exact document identity, never as a new predictor.
missing_sources: Keep every CVE; exclude absent/disabled sources from attention. No missing-source text or synthetic embeddings.
reuse: D checkpoint references unchanged. Reuse graph chunks only for exact text, source/platform identity, offsets, CVE role and processing-resource identity.
storage: Verified external chunk references, not copies, hard links or symlinks; preserve referenced source caches. New chunks are local. All referenced files are hash-checked before training.
interpretation: Retrospective VulnCheck snapshot classification, not historical forecasting or causal impact of social discussion.
